payload.rationale: One capability with existing Issue 60 is the simplest complete and enforceable decomposition: no new work items are permitted or needed, while ordered durable gates inside the issue preserve exact provenance from a finite repository inventory through non-destructive reconciliation, exact-SHA assurance, governed merge, and immutable artifact publication. The repository has no configured server/browser production target; .github/workflows/burrito-release.yml is the canonical provider path and publishes four Burrito binaries with checksums. Central acancelas/bos-mcp Goal 216 is coordination context only. This avoids temporary contracts, shadow issues, invented deployment targets, and any weakening of Goal 59.

capabilities.title: Consolidate Symphony and publish one verified immutable release
capabilities.context: Goal 59 is the Symphony repository slice of central BOS Goal 216. origin/main is currently the v0.2.1 commit while many local/remote refs and worktrees contain divergent histories. Symphony is an Elixir/OTP orchestrator whose high-value boundaries include GameApiTrackerAdapter-only BOS access, host-side credentials, repository serialization, process-wide provider circuits, durable RFC 8785/hash-chained audit outbox recovery, immutable claims, safe workspace recovery, subprocess reaping, token budgets, and exact-revision delivery. Its configured production channel is the GitHub Actions Burrito release workflow for linux_x86_64, linux_arm64, macos_x86_64 and macos_arm64; no continuously running production target is configured.
capabilities.expectedOutcome: Every substantive Symphony history in a frozen inventory is integrated, proven equivalent/superseded, or explicitly excluded with evidence without deleting or rewriting sources; one clean pushed candidate with the next unused SemVer and fail-closed immutable release behavior passes complete exact-SHA validation and risk-adaptive review, merges through the governed PR path, and is published once as a checksum-verified four-platform release with durable BOS receipts.
scope: Freeze a finite execution-start inventory of all Symphony worktrees, local refs, origin refs, ref tips, ahead/behind state, dirty/untracked status and unique commits.
Disposition every inventoried history with exact source identity and rationale; integrate every substantive history using ordinary non-force Git operations while preserving all source state.

Resolve semantic overlap across orchestrator, GameApiTrackerAdapter, scheduler/claims/capacity, provider circuits, outbox/audit canonicalization and recovery, Goal authorization, workspace cleanup/recovery, subprocess cancellation, telemetry, dashboard, tracker adapters and release paths without weakening AGENTS.md contracts.
Set the candidate to the next unused SemVer 0.2.2 and ensure release automation fails closed on existing tag/release/assets and never clobbers published assets.
Bind targeted tests, repository gates, reviews, evidence, PR, merge, tag, release, binaries and checksums to exact immutable commit identities.
Use bos-mcp/game-api exclusively for durable BOS and governed provider operations; merge without bypass and verify the configured GitHub/Burrito production artifact channel.
outOfScope: Creating capabilities or Issues, mutating central Goal 216 or sibling repositories, or unrelated product expansion.
Deleting worktrees, refs, commits, untracked data or unrelated changes; force-push, reset-away, history rewrite or destructive cleanup.
Direct GitHub REST/GraphQL or gh-based Delivery operations outside the governed release workflow; exposing credentials to Codex.
Inventing a daemon, server, browser target, deployment URL or rollback contract absent from repository and BOS configuration.
Reusing/moving a tag, replacing release assets, bypassing checks, using stale-SHA evidence, weakening acceptance criteria or unbounded repairs.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable cutoff ledger accounts for every in-universe worktree/ref and unique history with exact identity, disposition and rationale; all substantive histories are integrated or have exact equivalence/supersession evidence and no source state is destroyed.

The exact clean pushed candidate contains version 0.2.2 and fail-closed no-clobber release behavior, is upstream-reachable, and passes conflict-targeted tests, applicable specs.check, the mandatory cd elixir && mise exec -- mix test gate, repository make all/full gates, security-boundary assertions, release workflow tests and an exact-owner zero-child process scan.

Functional/quality and architecture/security reviews pass on the exact SHA; concurrency/recovery review passes when scheduler/outbox/workspace/cancellation paths change; release-integrity review always passes; visual/browser review is required only if both UI changes and a configured target exist.
A governed PR merges the exact reviewed and evidenced SHA without bypass, and merged main, unused immutable tag v0.2.2 and release metadata all identify the same commit.

The release contains linux_x86_64, linux_arm64, macos_x86_64 and macos_arm64 binaries plus SHA-256 files; recomputed hashes and clean-install smoke behavior pass and durable BOS receipts cover every irreversible boundary.

If a pre-existing canonical runtime target is discovered before publication, execution pauses for a versioned scope decision defining provider, identity oracle, probes and rollback rather than inventing a temporary contract.

issues.title: Reconcile, verify and deliver the consolidated Symphony revision
issues.context: Existing GitHub Issue 60 is the sole executable work item. Its claim that integration is already complete must be verified against a newly frozen complete inventory. Durable handoffs inside this issue are the inventory/disposition ledger, candidate provenance map, exact-SHA validation/review bundle, governed merge receipt and release verification receipt.
issues.expectedOutcome: Issue 60 executes the complete gated path from finite history inventory through non-destructive reconciliation, candidate hardening, exact-SHA assurance, governed merge and immutable v0.2.2 four-platform publication.
scope: Gate 1: freeze and durably record the complete repository/worktree/ref inventory.
Gate 2: disposition all histories and reconcile substantive changes while preserving source state.
Gate 3: produce a clean candidate containing version 0.2.2 and fail-closed immutable release behavior.
Gate 4: push normally and obtain complete exact-SHA tests, required repository checks, evidence and risk-adaptive reviews, with at most two strictly-derived repair cycles.
Gate 5: govern PR/check/merge, create the unused tag/release once, verify four binaries/checksums/clean-install smoke, and persist the terminal exact-revision projection.
outOfScope: Assuming any consolidation ref is complete without ledger evidence.
New work items, cross-repository mutations, destructive or force operations, unrelated fixes, mutable assets, invented runtime deployment or acceptance weakening.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate 1 cannot pass until every in-universe worktree/ref is represented and the cutoff is immutable.
Gate 2 cannot pass until every substantive entry is integrated/equivalent/superseded with exact evidence and all source histories remain intact.
Gate 3 cannot pass until the candidate is clean, versioned 0.2.2, and release collisions/assets fail closed without clobber.
Gate 4 cannot pass until the exact pushed SHA is upstream-reachable and all applicable validations, evidence and required reviewers pass with no surviving owned OS child.
Gate 5 cannot start before Gate 4; PR head, merged main, tag, release and artifacts must converge on the same commit.
Post-publication verification confirms all four binaries/checksum files, recomputed hashes and clean-install smoke behavior, and BOS records exact durable receipts.

dependencies.rationale: Sole capability. Within issue-60-reconcile-verify-release the mandatory ordered dependency chain is inventory ledger -> disposition-complete integration -> hardened/versioned candidate -> exact-SHA validation/reviews/evidence -> governed merge -> immutable tag/release -> artifact verification.

risks.context: Divergent refs/worktrees may contain unique substantive work.
risks.mitigation: Immutable inventory cutoff, exact disposition ledger, preserved source state, non-force operations and fail-closed handling of dirty/unreadable worktrees.

risks.context: Overlapping changes affect concurrency, recovery, audit and authorization invariants.
risks.mitigation: Conflict-targeted tests, full gates, exact-SHA functional/architecture/concurrency reviews and no more than two strictly-derived repair cycles.

risks.context: Direct provider access or leaked credentials would violate BOS architecture.
risks.mitigation: GameApiTrackerAdapter and bos-mcp/game-api exclusively; host-side secrets; command policy and architecture/security review.

risks.context: A reused tag, clobbered asset or stale evidence could publish the wrong revision.
risks.mitigation: Unused v0.2.2 collision checks, fail-closed workflow, no clobber, exact-SHA binding and immutable post-publication verification.

risks.context: No server/browser runtime target is configured.
risks.mitigation: Treat the configured Burrito artifact release as production; require a versioned scope decision if a real pre-existing runtime target is discovered.
Use global BOS state read-only for coordination and restrict all mutations to acancelas/symphony.
